title: Roadmap - Rollercoaster.dev

meta.description: A realistic snapshot of where we are and what's next (2025–2026).

heading: Roadmap

item0.description: Prototyped and working, but in progress: modular-server, UI, and system. Tracked via GitHub issue cards on the landing page. Target: publish the system prototype by end of 2025.

item1.description: Stabilize modular-server & UI; define MVP scope; publish first contributor docs; open “help wanted” issues.

item2.description: MVP: self‑issued badge wallet backed by modular-server; limited VC export (Open Badges 3.x).

item3.description: Peer/mentor verification pilot and feedback loops (depends on partners & funding).

item4.description: Enhanced visualizations and mobile layout polish.

item5.description: Community building, outreach, partnerships, and fundraising.

transparency: We keep this realistic: items may shift. We’ll link to GitHub issues/PRs as they exist.
